name: Rio de Janeiro
tagline: A century-old quindim at Confeitaria Colombo, and two Michelin stars steps from Copacabana.

Confeitaria Colombo.description: A historic 1894 pastry shop, a Rio icon. Its quindim was named one of the world's most iconic desserts by TasteAtlas.

Oro.description: Signature cuisine from chef Felipe Bronze in Leblon, one of the few Brazilian restaurants with two Michelin stars.

Lasai.description: Ingredients from its own garden in Humaitá, from chef Rafa Costa e Silva. Two Michelin stars and 28th on The World's 50 Best 2025.

Mee.description: Refined Asian cuisine inside the legendary Copacabana Palace. One Michelin star.

Garota de Ipanema.description: The boteco where Vinícius de Moraes and Tom Jobim wrote "Garota de Ipanema" in 1962. The street next door bears the poet's name.
